status.description: Lifecycle status of the workflow integration on this document revision. The server blocks recycle (and other writes that would orphan an in-flight external workflow instance) when status is `created`, `creation_requested`, or `termination_requested`. Recycle is permitted when status is absent, `not_created`, `failed`, `ended`, `terminated`, or `termination_failed`. Note that `created` alone is the only status that indicates a workflow is _currently active_ — `creation_requested` and `termination_requested` are transitional states where a request is in flight against the external workflow service, and clients must treat them as blocking even though the workflow is not yet active.

post.description:
Download the files associated with the specified Document Revisions as a ZIP archive.

By default the response is a 302 redirect to a presigned ZIP URL in the Location header. Pass `no_redirect=true` to receive 200 `{ data: { download_url, url_expires_at } }` instead.

Document revisions without a file are silently omitted from the ZIP, so the archive may contain fewer files than IDs requested. `download_all_document_revisions` is currently disabled — an empty `document_revision_ids` list returns 400. At most 300 unique document revision IDs may be requested.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Company ID

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID

parameters.name: no_redirect

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"document_revision_ids\":[\"string\"],\"download_all_document_revisions\":true}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v2.1/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/document_management/document_revisions/download?no_redirect=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
